# xidm1

## Files

- disks.nix
- default.nix
- network.nix
- minimal.nix

## File Summaries

### disks.nix
Board now boots via UEFI from SPI flash (LibreTech firmware). Layout: EFI system partition + ext4 root. No U-Boot reservation needed.

### default.nix
NixOS ARM host configuration for xidm1 (Kanidm 3rd read-replica + last-resort

### network.nix
Static network configuration for xidm1 (formerly xts2) Re-IP'd onto the server VLAN (VLAN 20, 172.20.1.0/24) 2026-08-21 so Kanidm replication (port 8444) stays same-subnet as xsvr1/xsvr2, and so xidm1 can join the idm keepalived VIP (172.20.1.110) — see modules/services/keepalived/default.nix. Interface: Amlogic DWMAC platform device typically stays eth0 on mainline Linux. Verify with `ip -brief addr` on first boot and update if different.

### minimal.nix
Minimal SD image configuration for xidm1 (formerly xts2); deploy with deploy-rs after boot.

## Overview

This folder contains the following files with their respective purposes summarized above.
